requirements.requirement: A user signs in with username and password and receives a session token; invalid credentials are rejected with an explicit error and no token is issued.
user_flows: Sign in with valid credentials
Sign in with a wrong password and read the Spanish error

requirements.requirement: An administrator creates a customer with name, national document, phone and email, and lists the registered customers.
user_flows: Register a customer from the form
Read the customer table

requirements.requirement: An administrator registers a vehicle owned by an existing customer with plate, VIN, brand, model and year; a duplicate plate or a duplicate VIN is rejected.
user_flows: Register a vehicle choosing its owner from the real customer list
Read the rejection when the plate or the VIN already exists

requirements.requirement: An administrator opens a service order for a vehicle at check-in with the failure reported by the customer and the reception date; the order is created in RECEIVED status.
user_flows: Open a service order from the check-in form
Filter the order list by status

requirements.requirement: An administrator assigns a technician to a service order; the assignment is rejected when that technician already holds a service order that has not reached DELIVERED.
user_flows: Assign an available technician from the allocation panel
Read the Spanish rejection when the technician is already busy

requirements.requirement: The assigned technician records the diagnostic of a service order with the finding and the components to repair, which moves the order to IN_DIAGNOSIS.
user_flows: Record the diagnostic as the assigned technician
Read the stored diagnostic in the order detail

requirements.requirement: The assigned technician registers an intervention on a service order with description, labor hours and the parts used; the first intervention moves the order to IN_REPAIR.
user_flows: Register an intervention adding one row per part used
Read the intervention list of the order

requirements.requirement: A service order advances from IN_REPAIR to READY and from READY to DELIVERED; a transition outside the declared lifecycle is rejected and the order keeps its previous status.
user_flows: Advance the order with the button that offers only the next declared status
Read the Spanish rejection when the backend refuses the transition

requirements.requirement: Every service order status change is persisted as a transition record with the previous status, the new status, the author and the timestamp.
user_flows: Read the status history panel of the order after an advance

requirements.requirement: An administrator issues a warranty over an intervention with kind LABOR or PART and a coverage in months; the expiration date is computed as the issue date plus the coverage.
user_flows: Issue a warranty from a recorded intervention
Read the issued warranty in the warranty table

requirements.requirement: The system reports for any warranty whether it is valid or expired at the date being consulted, comparing that date against the expiration date.
user_flows: Choose a consultation date and read the valid or expired badge of each warranty

requirements.requirement: An administrator consults the clinical timeline of a vehicle and reads, in chronological order, its service orders, diagnostics, interventions and warranties.
user_flows: Open the clinical history from a vehicle row
Read the chronological entries of the vehicle

requirements.requirement: An administrator reads a dashboard with the number of open service orders, the count of service orders grouped by status, and the technicians currently holding an active order.
user_flows: Read the open order count and the card per status
Read the table of occupied technicians
